projects.title: A bowling day out for the Sivapoomi kids
projects.summary: We are arranging a day at the bowling lanes for the special-needs children of Sivapoomi: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.
projects.story:
## Summary

We are arranging a bowling day for the special-needs children of Sivapoomi: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.

## The need

A day out for a whole group of children with special needs takes transport, extra helpers and a budget, so it does not happen often. These are exactly the days a child remembers.

## The plan

A full day at the bowling lanes, where every child gets a turn and every roll gets a cheer, with transport, food and helpers arranged for the group.

The project has been **initiated**. We have requested the budget for the day and are waiting for a response. As soon as it is ready, it will be shown on this page.

## What it leaves behind

A happy memory for every child. After the day we will share the story and the pictures here, so that everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.

projects.title: An arcade trip for the orphanage kids
projects.summary: We are planning a trip to the arcade for children from an orphanage: games, lights, prizes and a day made just for them.
projects.story:
## Summary

We are planning a trip to the arcade for children from an orphanage: games, lights, prizes and a day made just for them.

## The need

Children growing up in a home rarely get a day that is only about fun. A few hours of games and little prizes is a small thing to give and a big thing to receive.

## The plan

An afternoon at the arcade where the only thing the children have to do is play, with transport, food and helpers arranged for the group.

The project has been **initiated**. We are waiting for the budget and the other details of the trip. As soon as they are ready, they will be shown on this page.

## What it leaves behind

A day the children will talk about for a long time. After the trip we will share the story and the pictures here, so that everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.
